title: Run cloud migration setup for Dynamics GP migration

facts.text: Any delegated administrator running cloud migration setup must receive approval from a licensed SUPER user with Essentials or Premium license.
User running setup must be signed in as administrator of both Microsoft Entra tenant and Business Central online.
Sign in to Microsoft 365 tenant and Business Central online.
Open Cloud Migration Setup assisted setup and accept the warning and privacy notice.
Select Product matching the on-premises version being migrated.
Fill in SQL database connection details and integration runtime information.
Select one or more companies to migrate or enable All Companies.
On GP Company Migration Configuration page select companies and enable Automatic Validation if desired.
